messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(These are the federal holidays that either fall on a weekday or are observed on a weekday when they land on a weekend.  Provincial holidays such as Family Day vary by province – the dates below are for the provinces that observe it on the same day.)

| Long Weekend | Holiday(s) | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|------------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | Jan 1 was a Sunday; the holiday is observed on Monday. |
| **Family Day** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, etc.) | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Family Day fell on Monday Feb 20. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday was on Friday; the weekend follows. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day was on Monday May 22. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Jul 1 was a Saturday; the holiday is observed on Monday. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day was on Monday Sep 4. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving was on Monday Oct 9. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13) | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Nov 11 was a Saturday; observed on Monday. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas was on Monday Dec 25. |
| **Boxing Day** | Boxing Day | **Dec 24 – Dec 26** | Boxing Day was on Tuesday Dec 26. |

**Quick takeaways for your app**

- **Weekend holidays** (e.g., New Year’s, Canada Day, Remembrance Day) are usually observed on the following Monday, creating a 3‑day stretch that includes the weekend.
- **Weekday holidays** that fall on a Monday (Family Day, Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving) give a 3‑day weekend that includes the preceding Saturday‑Sunday.
- **Friday holidays** (Good Friday) give a 3‑day weekend that includes the following Saturday‑Sunday.
- **Boxing Day** on a Tuesday adds a 4‑day stretch (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday‑Tuesday).

Feel free to plug these date ranges into your holiday‑planning logic!
